question: Select the correct pair of Indian classical dancers of Odissi style.

options.text: Meenakshi Sundaram Pillai and Savitha Sastry

solution:
The correct answer is **__Sujata Mohapatra and Madhavi Mudgal__**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• Classical dance forms in India include Bharatnatyam, Kuchipudi, Odissi, Kathakali, Mohiniyattam etc.
 
• Odissi is a classical dance from the Odisha state that follows Natya Sastra principles.
 
 
• Sujata Mohapatra and Madhavi Mudgal are among the famous **Odissi **dancers in India.
 
 
 
• **Madhavi Mudgal** is a classical dancer in Odissi, but she also learned **Bharatnatyam **and **Kathak**.
 
• She won the Sanskriti Award in 1984, Padma Sri Award in 1990, and the Orissa state Sangeet Natak Akademi Award in 2000.
